name: skillz
description: Ramazan's personal Claude Code skills. Each skill lives under skills/<name>/SKILL.md; add more by dropping in new folders. One hook (hooks/hooks.json) serves the reflex skill's procedures and is a no-op unless a config dir opts in. Includes a modified fork of herdr's AGPL-3.0 skill; the bundle is licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later (see repo LICENSE/NOTICE).
